status: internal candidate; not a supported provider protocol

rules.identity: execution + slot + generation, issued by provider; payload and namespace stay private
rules.attribution: immutable root attribution across child/result ownership handoff
rules.authority: completion tickets, resource authority and cleanup authority are distinct
rules.calls: validate and fence all input claims before dispatch; record all outcomes and observed outputs before resuming
rules.failure: status does not infer consumption, quiescence, acceptance or refund
rules.unknown: quarantine; no reuse, retry, optimistic release or automatic fallback
rules.cleanup: bounded provider-declared actions; never substitute commit for abandon
rules.settlement: effect settlement does not dispose resources
rules.refund: RA-02 decision; no capacity algorithm in this contract
rules.evidence: binding identity and scoped opaque record identity; no raw handles or payloads
